items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So I tried, and we got a little group together, and we couldn't get nobody to cooperate 'cause she's singin' blues

ctx.x: So I just left. So I'm around there. So I hit Broadway now. Now I'm hustling, hustling songs, see. And I'm a rhythm guitar player; I'm not a fast fly guitar player leading in order to be up front. You know, they got them cats got them groups and they're playin'. So I figured I'd do a little thing with my old lady.

So I tried, and we got a little group together, and we couldn't get nobody to cooperate 'cause she's singin' blues -- and they look at you after a while. You know, I had two or three cats, and one of them told me... I booked them, and we played the first night -- and he was one of them Muslims, I can't think of his name. A piano player... And we washed him, washed his clothes, fed him, gave him some money and everything. And we're going to Montreal. We
